title: How the model works: mechanisms of cellprograms
text: cell type independently, package fits two-factor model Y \approx L F^T + E, Y (preprocessed) observations x genes matrix, L sample-side factors (program scores), F gene-side factors (program loadings), E residual noise. fit flashier’s empirical-Bayes matrix factorization: Greedy addition + backfitting. Factors added one time (greedy_Kmax = max_factors), new factor capturing largest remaining structured variation; greedy addition, factors jointly re-estimated (backfitting) evidence lower bound (ELBO) stops improving. nullcheck()-style pruning removes factors improve ELBO. Sparsity via empirical Bayes. factor’s loadings get point-Laplace prior (spike zero plus Laplace slab), fitted ebnm::ebnm_point_laplace. spike shrinks small loadings strongly toward zero slab admits large effects, giving programs sparse character — stored posterior means small nonzero values, exact zeros. Extract gene sets explicit loading threshold lfsr (top_genes(..., = "lfsr")), filtering exact zeros. point_normal (Gaussian slab) unimodal available alternatives. Noise model. var_type controls residual variance structure: 0 = one variance everything, 1 = one per observation (default, right pseudobulk donors differ depth/quality), 2 = one per gene, c(1, 2) = Kronecker rank-one. default selected full-factorial tuning benchmark (see README). Preprocessing. center = TRUE centers gene (default); scale = TRUE also scale unit variance (default — raw program amplitudes kept). features = "variable" restricts fit top n_variable_genes variable genes per cell type. covariate_mode = "residualize" (hard): pseudobulk matrix residualized covariate design (e.g. sequencing institute, sex) ordinary least squares factorization. Programs fit covariate-free residual expression. covariate_mode = "fixed" (soft, SOFA-style): covariate columns enter factorization fixed sample-side factors unshrunk gene effects, initialized OLS; free programs added greedily alongside everything except fixed columns backfit. covariate part returned separately (fixed_L, fixed_F) never appears program extraction. Degenerate inputs. Genes identically zero preprocessing dropped; cell type informative genes records K = 0 fit instead failing analysis. fitted object stores, per cell type, posterior means posterior SDs factor matrices (L_pm/L_psd, F_pm/F_psd), ELBO trajectory, gene panel used. Posterior SDs later power mashr sharing analysis.
code: fit <- fit_celltype_programs(x, loading_prior = "point_laplace",                              max_factors = 10, var_type = 1) fit <- canonicalize_programs(fit)

text: CMP set programs >= 2 cell types whose donor-level scores co-vary — track one shared latent donor activity. Gene overlap plays role call. procedure: Rank-first scores. program’s donor scores rank-transformed normal scores, residualized blocking strata. Point-Laplace priors produce single-donor spike factors break Pearson-based max-T calibration; ranks remove failure mode. Ambient filter. Programs whose loadings track another cell type’s expression specificity (ambient RNA / doublet leakage) dropped (ambient = "drop") flagged (ambient = "flag"), using ambient_program_scores(). Edge statistic. every cross-cell-type program pair (donors two cell types share), T = \tanh^{-1}(r)\sqrt{n-3} r Pearson correlation residualized Gaussian-rank scores step 1. strata close Spearman correlation donor scores (Pearson ranks), residualization rank transform makes distinction material strata present. Edges |T| \ge link_threshold (default 3) link programs. Node statistic. program’s evidence pooled across partner cell types: A_v = \sum_c \max(0, \max_u |T_{vu}| - \tau)^2 — program correlated many partners stronger evidence one correlated single partner. Permutation null. Donor rows permuted within strata, independently per cell type — removes cross-cell-type coupling keeping within-cell-type structure. Program p-values adjusted permutation maximum (single-step max-T), family-wise error rate calling CMP controlled alpha. Clustering. Significant programs grouped CMPs edge structure; cmp_scores() summarizes CMP donor-level consensus score. mode = "within" tests structure within levels context variable (e.g. severity) — coordination survives artifact case/control composition.

text: Sharing different axis coordination: two cell types can use biological program (shared gene loadings) uncorrelated donor scores, vice versa. program_sharing() assesses shared loadings post hoc mashr (Urbut et al. 2019), never assuming : Mapping: units = genes shared panel; conditions = cell types; effects = canonicalized program loadings; standard errors = flashier loading posterior SDs (scale-canonicalized like loadings). Residual variance V estimated “null” genes (|z| < z_thresh conditions); null genes exist, V = identity warning. Covariances: canonical covariance matrices, plus data-driven ones PCA strong effects (npc); data-driven set numerically non-positive-semi-definite (small condition counts), fit falls back canonical-warning. Classification: matched group, n_top genes largest posterior-mean effects counted. gene counts shared lfsr < lfsr_thresh least two conditions (signs compared), private significant exactly one. group classified shared >= half top genes shared, private >= half private, else partial. Programs significant cross-cell-type match labeled private without mashr fit (evidence = "no_significant_match"). summary reports frac_top_shared / frac_top_private evidence source. Note criterion significance-based, sign-based: gene significant two conditions opposite posterior signs still counts shared.
code: shr <- program_sharing(fit, n_perm = 199, z_thresh = 1.5) shr$summary   # one row per program: shared / partial / private

what: Numerically degenerate programs, two kinds: 1. flashier can retain factors whose loadings underflow to numerical noise (median |loading| many orders of magnitude below the cell type's strongest program; e.g. sparse factors whose support is a few genes and whose remaining entries sit at ~1e-16). Their posterior SDs underflow as well, producing garbage z-scores, and correlation-based matching is scale-invariant, so they spuriously match every strong program. 2. Fixed, never-updated factors: real-scale loadings whose posterior SD column collapsed to machine precision (observed for the smallest cell type in both real cohorts). Point estimates without usable uncertainty: mashr cannot assess them. A program is degenerate when median |loading| < `rel_tol` x the cell type's largest, or when its median posterior SD (scaled to the loadings) is <= `sd_floor`. — .degenerate_programs
